summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Barang Management system. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate), but frontend has Mixed Content security issue preventing HTTPS→HTTP requests.

integration_issues.issue: Mixed Content error: Frontend (HTTPS) trying to make HTTP requests to backend instead of HTTPS
integration_issues.error_message: Mixed Content: The page at 'https://stickerlab-5.preview.emergentagent.com/barang' was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure XMLHttpRequest endpoint 'http://state-asset-app.preview.emergentagent.com/api/barang/'. This request has been blocked; the content must be served over HTTPS.

success_percentage.frontend: 70% (UI works, API integration blocked by Mixed Content)

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix Mixed Content security issue. The React app's axios configuration is not properly using the HTTPS backend URL from environment variables. Despite hardcoding HTTPS URL in axios.js, the app still makes HTTP requests. This suggests an environment variable loading issue or build configuration problem. Need to ensure REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is properly loaded at build time.
